title: Page 3
content_zh:
“谢谢你的关心，我不会的，因为看到客人就好像看到一张巨大的钞票在我面前晃啊晃，我开心都来不及，怎么可能精神分裂。”

许安安受不了的狠狠翻了个大白眼当做回应。

白薇秀无所谓的耸耸肩。这世间啊，爱情什么的最虚幻了，好吧，她承认，身为婚顾师有这样的心态是不对的，要知道走进“一生一世”的新人们都是相信爱情是世上最值得投资、最美好的事物，要不然怎么可能携手走向红毯的另一端，偏偏她却认为爱情是狗屁，噗一下，就什么都没有了。

抱歉，她粗鲁了，但她是真的这么想。

“薇秀，真的，你就听一下我的劝，钱不是万能，钱买不到真诚的爱—— ”

她毫不客气的打断道：“我听你在放屁！别把钱跟爱情相提并论，钱很实在、爱很虚幻……”当她正打算长篇大论爱情无用时，就见一辆昂贵房车停到店门口，一对璧人下了车走了进来，她立刻将挡住她看大型钞票飘进来的许安安一把推开，随即堆起最最和善的笑容，用最专业有礼的态度道：“欢迎，有任何需要，我都可以为您服务。”

真的是“贵”客临门！

说话的同时，白薇秀已经迅速扫过男客人手腕上价值不菲的名表，还有那一身手工订制西装，女客人手中所提的名牌包需要提前订制，价格快要破七位数字，还有她无名指上那一颗闪亮的钻石戒指。

她需要用尽全身的力气才有办法忍住不大笑出声，随即她犀利的目光一扫，一名工读生妹妹即刻端来上等红茶招待客人，白薇秀亲自领他们进入贵宾室，举手投足间显示出她的热诚，却又不能过于巴结，更不能过度吹嘘。

依照她的经验，超高贵的客人，通常越低调，要不然也不会找上他们这间小店了。

果然，白薇秀猜对了。

这对贵客光论外表，男的高帅、女的娇美，非常赏心悦目，堪称天作之合，光是站在一起就好似会发光，让人忍不住多看好几眼。

男客人递出名片，银蓝色的底面，上头仅有公司名、头衔，跟一组手机号码。

白薇秀低头瞄了一眼。约里顾问公司总经理，赵霖，原来是开顾问公司的，难怪一张俊俏的脸蛋颇带桃花样，浓眉大眼，笑起来还有酒窝，举止绅士，打扮优雅合宜又时尚，以她看男人的挑剔目光，他有九十九分，至于被扣掉的那一分……是因为有所保留。

不知怎地，以她那敏锐的双面人直觉，赵霖绝对不像表面上看起来那般的和蔼亲切、有礼幽默，或许是因为她意外捕捉到他眸底那一闪而过的阴沉打量。

不过话说回来，他是怎样的人对她来说一点也不重要，只要他肯掏钱出来大办婚礼就行了。

至于女客人嘛……嗯，有点面熟，不过她不会很白目的直接问，看吧，对方主动递出名片，修长的十指做着漂亮的光疗指片，闪到她的眼。

颜芳菲？如果她没记错的话，应该是常常上时尚新闻，听说是名媛好感度排名前三的其中之一，她形象不错，也接拍一些代言广告，但更常为慈善团体发声，是个非常会行销自己的女人。

大概知道两名贵客新人的底之后，白薇秀再次肯定，他们会来，绝对是想在婚礼之前一切低调行事。

而她知晓他们的身分之后，态度仍旧不卑不亢，并未变得更巴结，这让赵霖跟颜芳菲有了决定。

他要结婚了。

一切按照行程进度表，精准，不允许出错。

至于人选颜芳菲，八面玲珑的交际手腕是他挑上她的主因，再加上他掌握了她的秘密，与她进行过商谈，条件交换双方也满意，于是定下婚期。

赵霖今年满三十岁，而立之年，他也的确没有凭父荫，自己创立约里顾问公司，并在业界闯出名号，除此之外，他还私下进行多方投资，他的眼光锐利独特，所投资的标的或公司没有不赚钱的，目前他台面上的身价已经上看五亿，还不包括来自赵氏食品集团的股票、红利跟现金配给。

赵氏食品集团，是他父亲赵耀山利用外祖父提供的资金一手创立的，目前产业已经扩展到大陆、香港等地，是很赚钱的集团。

身为长子，接管赵氏似乎是势在必行，但赵霖却不是很愿意，原因就出在他那个好到没话说、疼他比疼亲生儿女还要多的继母吴佩茹身上，还有，他还不想结婚却不得不找个对象的原因，也是因为她。

那个女人最近非常积极且好心的为他介绍许多名门淑女，其中的心计他清楚得很。

碍于表面上维持的和谐，再加上他可是个敬爱继母的好儿子，他当然和继母介绍的每个对象都约出去吃过饭，既然他的好继母那么急着塞人给他，他就顺应她的心意，不过结婚对象得由他亲自挑选。

颜芳菲是个聪明人，他开的条件也很好，他相信这场婚姻应该会很顺利愉悦。

接下来就是筹办婚礼的细节了。

身为顾问公司的总经理，他很清楚凡事交给专业就对了，他没空处理琐碎的结婚事宜，就把一切交给婚礼顾问公司，只是婚顾公司不能随便找，他不想在喜帖发送之前就让结婚消息曝了光，免得他的好继母从中破坏。

他让秘书挑了家小有名气却又不是很出名的小店，“一生一世”就这么雀屏中选了。

从一踏进门，赵霖的嘴边虽然挂着温和的浅笑，但实际上却不停的在观察，其中最重要的，是招呼他们的婚顾师，白薇秀。

她递出名片，是浪漫的紫色底面配上白边字，秀上姓名头衔，还有手机号码和店里的联络电话、LINE的ID等。

这位婚顾师满年轻的，以他目测，大约二十五岁，五官面容跟颜芳菲一比，当然是被比了下去，不过也算是长得不错的，至于身材，他不着痕迹的扫过一眼，不得不承认有惊艳到。

若拿她跟颜芳菲比，两个人差不多高，但由于颜芳菲非常在意上镜头的好看程度，她的体重是比标准低还要更低。

赵霖很是不解，那些所谓的女明星、名媛，在镜头前是好看，好像个个都是衣架子，可事实上对男人来说，抱起来一点都不舒服。

他跟颜芳菲就只有初识那晚有过亲密关系，也就是所谓的一夜情，将她列入合作伙伴后，他就再也没有碰过她了，坦白说，他对她也很难再有情欲。

瞧瞧眼前这位婚顾师，依他目测，至少Ｄ罩杯，至于腰呢，弧度美好到只要是男人都想抱抱看，臀形也美，双腿纤细修长更是性感。

好吧，他承认，他打量她的目光有一时片刻情欲化了，但他是个有正常需求的男人，看到身材美好的女人会情不自禁也无可厚非。

不过他很快的拉回心神，今天来这里办正事要紧，而且他还得扮演一个深情且沉浸于即将结婚喜悦中的快乐男人。

赵霖对白薇秀很是满意，不是指身材，而是她的服务态度，不逢迎拍马，也没有过分的夸耀，他需要的正是这样的人，能够低调筹办婚事，就算要公开大肆宣传，也要等到婚礼前一个礼拜准备寄送喜帖时，这样才能给他那自以为是的后母重重的打击。

赵霖直接提出他的要求，在婚事公开以前，“一生一世”必须完全封口，一个字都不许对外提起。
content_en:
"Thank you for your concern. I won't, because seeing guests is like seeing a huge banknote dangling in front of me. I can't even be happy. How can I be schizophrenic."

Xu Anan couldn't bear it and rolled his eyes in response.

Bai Weixiu shrugged indifferently.In this world, love is the most illusory thing. Well, she admits that as a wedding counselor, it is wrong to have such a mentality. You must know that couples who enter "One Life to Live" believe that love is the most worthy investment and the most beautiful thing in the world. Otherwise, how would they be able to walk hand in hand to the other end of the red carpet. However, she thinks that love is bullshit. Suddenly, there is nothing.

Sorry, she was rude, but she really meant it.

"Weixiu, really, just listen to my advice, money is not everything, money cannot buy sincere love -"

She interrupted unceremoniously: "I heard you farting! Don't compare money with love. Money is very real and love is illusory..." Just when she was about to talk about the uselessness of love at length, she saw an expensive RV parked in front of the store, and a pair of beautiful women.After getting out of the car and walking in, she immediately pushed Xu Anan away who was blocking her from watching the large bills floating in. Then she put on the kindest smile and said in the most professional and courteous manner: "Welcome, if you need anything, I can serve you."

It’s really an “expensive” guest!

While speaking, Bai Weixiu had quickly glanced at the valuable watch on the wrist of the male guest, as well as the hand-made suit. The brand-name bag in the hand of the female guest needed to be ordered in advance, and the price was almost seven figures, as well as the shining diamond ring on her ring finger.

She had to use all her strength to hold back from laughing out loud. Then with a sharp glance, a working-study girl immediately brought the best black tea to entertain the guests. Bai Weixiu personally led them into the VIP room, showing her enthusiasm in every gesture, but she could not be too flattering, let alone overly boastful.

According to her experience, ultra-noble customers are usually more low-key, otherwise they would not come to their small shop.

Sure enough, Bai Weixiu guessed correctly.

In terms of appearance, this pair of distinguished guests, the man is tall and handsome, the woman is delicate, are very pleasing to the eye, and they are a match made in heaven. They seem to glow just by standing together, and people can't help but look at them several times.

The male customer handed over his business card. It had a silver-blue background and only had the company name, title, and a mobile phone number on it.

Bai Weixiu glanced down.Zhao Lin, the general manager of Yuoli Consulting Company, used to run a consulting company. No wonder he has a handsome face with peach blossoms, thick eyebrows and big eyes, and dimples when he smiles. He behaves like a gentleman, and is dressed elegantly, appropriately and fashionably. With her critical look at men, he scored ninety-nine points. As for the point that was deducted... it was because of reservations.

Somehow, with her keen double-faced intuition, Zhao Lin was definitely not as kind, polite, and humorous as he seemed on the surface. Perhaps it was because she accidentally caught the flash of gloomy glance in his eyes.

But then again, it doesn't matter to her what kind of person he is, as long as he is willing to spend money to hold a grand wedding.

As for the female guest...well, she looks familiar, but she won't ask directly. Look, the other party took the initiative to hand over her business card, and her long fingers were doing beautiful phototherapy fingertips, which flashed into her eyes.

Yan Fangfei?If she remembers correctly, she should often be in the fashion news. I heard that she is one of the top three favored ladies. She has a good image and has also done some endorsement ads, but she often speaks out for charity groups. She is a woman who is very good at marketing herself.

After roughly knowing the background of the two distinguished guests, Bai Weixiu once again confirmed that they would come. She definitely wanted to keep everything low-key before the wedding.

But after she learned their identities, her attitude remained neither humble nor overbearing and did not become more fawning. This made Zhao Lin and Yan Fangfei make a decision.

He is getting married.

Everything is in accordance with the itinerary schedule, accurately, and no mistakes are allowed.

As for the choice of Yan Fangfei, her smooth communication skills were the main reason why he chose her. In addition, he had mastered her secrets, negotiated with her, and both parties were satisfied with the exchange of terms, so they set a wedding date.

Zhao Lin turns 30 this year. In his thirties, he did not rely on his father's influence. He founded the Yoli Consulting Company and made a name for himself in the industry. In addition, he also made private investments in multiple parties. He has a sharp and unique vision. There are no unprofitable targets or companies in which he invests. His current net worth is already over 500 million, not including the stocks, dividends and cash allocations from Zhao's Food Group.

Zhao's Food Group was founded by his father, Zhao Yaoshan, with funds provided by his grandfather. Currently, the industry has expanded to mainland China, Hong Kong and other places, and it is a very profitable group.

As the eldest son, it seemed inevitable to take over the Zhao family, but Zhao Lin was not very willing. The reason was because of his stepmother Wu Peiru, who was so kind that she loved him more than her own children. Also, the reason why he had to find a partner despite not wanting to get married was also because of her.

That woman had recently been very active and kind-hearted in introducing him to many famous ladies, and he knew her scheming very well.

Due to the harmony maintained on the surface, and the fact that he was a good son who respected and loved his stepmother, of course he had gone out to dinner with everyone introduced by his stepmother. Since his good stepmother was so eager to give him someone, he would comply with her wishes, but he had to choose the marriage partner himself.

Yan Fangfei is a smart man, and the conditions he offered are also very good. He believes that this marriage should be smooth and enjoyable.

Next comes the details of planning the wedding.

As the general manager of a consulting company, he knew very well that everything should be left to professionals. He had no time to deal with trivial wedding matters, so he left everything to a wedding consulting company. However, wedding consulting companies could not be found casually. He did not want to let the news of the wedding be exposed before the wedding invitations were sent, lest his good stepmother spoil it.

He asked his secretary to pick a small shop that was famous but not very famous, and "For a Lifetime" was chosen.

From the moment he stepped in, Zhao Lin had a gentle smile on his lips, but he was actually observing them all the time. The most important thing was to greet their wedding consultant, Bai Weixiu.

She handed over the business card, which had a romantic purple background with white text, showing her name, title, mobile phone number, store contact number, LINE ID, etc.

This wedding consultant was quite young, about twenty-five years old according to his visual inspection. Compared with Yan Fangfei's facial features, of course, she was inferior, but she was still pretty good-looking. As for her figure, he glanced at her without any trace, and he had to admit that he was surprised.

If we compare her with Yan Fangfei, they are about the same height, but because Yan Fangfei is very concerned about how good she looks on camera, her weight is even lower than the standard.

Zhao Lin was very puzzled. Those so-called female celebrities and socialites looked good in front of the camera, and they all seemed like clothes hangers, but in fact, they were not comfortable at all for men to hold.

He and Yan Fangfei only had an intimate relationship the night they first met, which was a so-called one-night stand. After adding her as a partner, he never touched her again. Frankly speaking, it was difficult for him to have any lust for her.

Take a look at the wedding consultant in front of you. According to his visual inspection, it is at least a D cup. As for the waist, the curve is so beautiful that any man would want to hug it. The shape of the buttocks is also beautiful, and the slender and slender legs are even more sexy.

Okay, he admitted that the way he looked at her turned erotic for a moment, but he was a man with normal needs, and it was understandable that he couldn't help but see a woman with a beautiful figure.

But he quickly regained his composure. He came here today to do business, and he also had to act as a happy man who was affectionate and immersed in the joy of getting married.

Zhao Lin was very satisfied with Bai Weixiu, not in terms of her figure, but in terms of her service attitude. She did not flatter her or show off excessively. What he needed was just such a person who could arrange the wedding in a low-key manner. Even if it was to be publicly publicized, he would have to wait until a week before the wedding to prepare to send the wedding invitations, so as to deal a heavy blow to his self-righteous stepmother.

Zhao Lin directly made his request. Before the marriage was made public, "for the rest of my life" must be completely sealed and not a word was allowed to be mentioned to the outside world.
